title: I’m building my own personal AI system from scratch how far would you take this?
author: Money_Ad4075

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: honestly the first thing I'd want is for it to say when it doesn't know, before any of the managing my life stuff. an assistant that confidently remembers the wrong goal is worse than one that forgets.

replies.author: Money_Ad4075
replies.body: Yeah, I agree. Max is still early, and I want it to be clear about what it knows, what it’s assuming, and when it needs to ask me. Especially with memory—if it’s unsure about a goal or thinks it’s changed, I’d want it to check with me before acting on it. Getting that right is part of the foundation.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: checking before acting on a changed goal is the right default. the failure I'd watch for is it asking so often you start clicking yes without reading.

replies.author: HFT0DTE
replies.body:
I built this last year and in terms of help I would say the following. What you are essentially building is a custom harness. A year ago the top foundational models were great but looped at the end of their context window with the same problems over and over. You've already hit on them in terms of what you want Max to do and not do. At the time I had to reverse engineer Claude Code's internal harness and there was even a great leak at the tail end of last year where you really got the goods from Anthropic on this and it helped a lot to run it within my own harness with essentially a partial lobotomy that enhanced it's best parts while silencing its rogue parts. 

Fast forward to today, I'm not working from a different direction where the harness is still important but its clear the frontier labs are providing enough of the puzzle pieces out of the box that it doesn't make sense to try to build as much of the harness at all. It's a far more simple build and a far better and more powerful architecture. 

The mistake I would avoid is building anything to sell to others. Build what YOU want for YOUR needs. Everyone will either have the ability to customize agents to do all this to their liking out of the box with even things like Muse for free or direct agents to behave like they want without encoding it in software.

The money is going to be in highly niche specializations that no foundational model excels at without access to custom data. Everything else you should build for fun and make it personalized and tailored to your specific needs.
